notes: The hex board's terms (docs/hex-trial/v2/README.md), read by both engines under rules 1.0's water_crossings and block_grants. Integers only.
water_crossings.expand_cost: the capital an Expand costs on top of 15 + (wealth_tier - 3) when the house holds no land neighbour of the target, which it reaches across a water row of adjacency.csv.

block_grants.extra_hexes: how many more hexagons a Crown founding on a resolution-4 hexagon grants beside the seat, when they are open, unclaimed and resolution 4: the most populous first, ties to the lower fed_id.
